items.html: But the brains of Netzah, Hod, Yesod of Tevuna are extended in him always, and forever they are extended and coming, and this is the meaning of Olam HaBa, the world to come, for it is always extended and coming. And this is the difference between Olam HaBa, the world to come, and “destined to come,” for one is in Tevuna and the other in Bina, in the phase of the Netzah, Hod, Yesod within them, which become the brains of ZA. And this is what is written in the Book of Bahir, that the students asked Rabbi Rechumai, what is Olam HaBa, the world to come? He said to them, a world that has already come. And the matter is understood with what was written above.
